professionalSummary.text: Candidate has built and maintains SQL/Python pipelines for loading card-scheme settlement files and ledger extracts into the reconciliation warehouse.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate investigates unmatched settlement items with finance operations and documents root causes in the exception log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked the daily unmatched-item queue with two finance operations analysts, tracing each exception to fee mismatches, timing differences or duplicate captures, and recorded the root cause and resolution in the shared exception log.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate has delivered a measurable reduction in the unmatched-item backlog, reported against a documented baseline and time window.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Recruiter phone screen: candidate said the unmatched backlog 'came down by around 35 percent' while he was on the team and that the finance director was pleased; he did not have the monthly report to hand and could not say what the starting figure was.

skills.text: Candidate coordinates pipeline changes with the settlement operations and compliance teams during the monthly change window and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Presented pipeline changes at the monthly change-window review with settlement operations and compliance; my part covered the loader and the matching keys, while approval of the go-live date stayed with the finance engineering lead.
